hero.headline: Calmer skincare routines, built from what's already on your shelf.
hero.subheadline: Ritora reviews the products you already own, flags ingredient conflicts, and turns your shelf into a clear morning and night plan — shaped by your skin, not a shopping cart.

problem.headline: Most skincare routines don't fail from carelessness — they fail from missing decisions.
problem.body: You pick up good products, try to sequence them, and still wake up unsure. Ritora supplies the missing layer: clearer sequencing, safer pairings, and calmer daily choices.

problems.title: Shelf confusion
problems.body: You own good products and still wake up guessing what to use and what to skip.

problems.title: Silent ingredient stacking
problems.body: Strong actives stack across cleansers, toners, and serums — irritation shows up before the cause does.

problems.title: Buying over building
problems.body: Most routines don't need another serum. They need structure, sequencing, and safer decisions.

howItWorks.headline: Three calm steps from shelf clutter to daily clarity.
howItWorks.illustrationTitle: From morning to night, on repeat
howItWorks.illustrationBody: Ritora treats your routine as a living cycle. Each step carries forward what last night's actives mean for this morning — so the plan stays safe without you having to think about it.

steps.title: Tell Ritora about your skin
steps.body: Share skin type, concerns, sensitivities, goals, and routine preference so guidance starts from your real context — not a generic template.

steps.title: Map what's already on your shelf
steps.body: Add your current products so Ritora can reason through ingredient overlap, safety limits, and genuine gaps.

steps.title: Follow a calmer daily plan
steps.body: Get clear morning and evening guidance — safety rules first, then personalised to your goals and inventory.

features.headline: Everything you need to make calmer skincare decisions.
features.illustrationBody: Every recommendation passes through a deterministic safety layer before it is shaped to your goals. No surprises, no conflicting actives, no regret purchases.

featureItems.title: Inventory-first guidance
featureItems.body: Recommendations begin with the products on your shelf, not a shopping cart.

featureItems.title: Ingredient safety guardrails
featureItems.body: Conflict checks, overlap detection, and active-frequency awareness protect sensitive skin and cut guesswork.

featureItems.title: Skin-profile awareness
featureItems.body: Goals, sensitivities, skin tone, age, and ethnicity-aware considerations shape every recommendation.

featureItems.title: Privacy-first by default
featureItems.body: GDPR-aware handling, explicit consent, and careful data boundaries — built in, not bolted on.

featureItems.title: Public content that educates
featureItems.body: Open, searchable pages for learning. Private, personal routines for logged-in use.

featureItems.title: Calmer daily rituals
featureItems.body: A morning and night view that removes guesswork and keeps your routine consistent — even on busy days.

faq.headline: Built to earn trust before it asks for it.

faqItems.question: Is Ritora a medical product?
faqItems.answer: No. Ritora is a skincare decision-support product that helps you make safer day-to-day routine choices. It does not diagnose, treat, or replace a dermatologist.

faqItems.question: Do I need to buy new products to use it well?
faqItems.answer: No. Ritora is inventory-first. It helps you get more out of what you already own before suggesting anything new.

faqItems.question: Will it work for beginners?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Beginners and overwhelmed collectors are exactly who Ritora is built for — a simpler path to a safer routine.

faqItems.question: How is privacy handled?
faqItems.answer: Ritora uses explicit consent, careful data boundaries, and secure authentication. EU-aware handling is built in from day one.

faqItems.question: Which languages are supported?
faqItems.answer: English and Swedish are available from launch. Your preferred language can be changed any time from the settings page.

finalCta.headline: Turn your shelf into a calmer daily routine.
finalCta.body: Log in to pick up where you left off, or create a new account in under a minute. No spam, no pressure — cancel whenever.

footer.brandBlurb: Ritora helps you turn the products you already own into a calmer, safer daily routine.
